title: BUAP Personalization Profile
description: Portable personalization profile for BUAP agents, Siri adapters, app intents, and chat surfaces.

user_display_name.description: Name or handle the assistant should use for the user.

buddy_display_name.description: User-selected visible name for the main Buddy persona.

lil_buddy_display_name.description: User-selected visible name for the Lil Buddy persona.

buddy_profile_id.description: Personality template ID for the main Buddy slot.

lil_buddy_profile_id.description: Personality template ID for the Lil Buddy slot.

selected_profile_pack_id.description: Profile pack for the selected templates.

buddy_voice_style.description: Short label for the preferred visible tone/style.

buddy_personality_notes.description: Non-sensitive user-approved style notes for Buddy.

lil_buddy_personality_notes.description: Non-sensitive user-approved style notes for Lil Buddy.

lil_buddy_permission_mode.description: How much confirmation the host should request for Lil Buddy actions.

first_run_personalization_complete.description: True only when user_display_name, buddy_display_name, and lil_buddy_display_name are known.

last_confirmed_at.description: Date the personalization values were last confirmed, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.
